code: export const formatPrice=price=>{return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US',{style:'currency',currency:'USD'}).format(price);};export const formatCurrency=formatPrice;export const calculateTotal=items=>{return items.reduce((sum,item)=>sum+item.price*item.quantity,0);};export const getCartTotal=calculateTotal;export const calculateDiscount=function(total){let discountPercent=arguments.length>1&&arguments[1]!==undefined?arguments[1]:10;return total*(discountPercent/100);};export const generateOrderId=()=>{return`ORD-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2,9)}`;};export const validateEmail=email=>{const re=/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;return re.test(email);};export const validatePhoneNumber=phone=>{const re=/^[\d\s-\+()]{10,}$/;return re.test(phone);};export const getStarRating=rating=>{const fullStars=Math.floor(rating);const halfStar=rating%1!==0;let stars='⭐'.repeat(fullStars);if(halfStar)stars+='✨';return stars;};
